brands.evidence: Monzo on a free plan is the simpler and cheaper choice.
Revolut is better if you want to hold euros or travel often.

client_claims.text: Monzo charges £0 for card payments in a foreign currency.
There's no monthly cap and no weekend markup on Monzo card spending abroad.
client_claims.note: No extra charges on card spending abroad.

client_claims.text: Monzo gives you £200 free per 30 days, then 3%.
client_claims.note: Fact says £400 every 30 days in UK/EEA (unlimited if main bank); £200 applies only outside the EEA.

client_claims.text: Older articles say Monzo's EEA withdrawals are unlimited if it's your main bank.
client_claims.note: Fact confirms unlimited if Monzo is main bank, though the answer suggests it may have changed.

client_claims.text: Both are UK-licensed, with £120,000 FSCS protection.
Replacing a lost Monzo card abroad costs a flat £30 to ship outside the UK.
client_claims.note: No fact covers replacement card fees.

client_claims.text: Monzo is better for UK banking and human support.
